name: group_scene_op
description: Manage a group/scene's membership and per-member link behavior: add or remove a device as a controller/responder member, or update how a member is triggered.

group_address.description: Real id of the group/scene, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.

link_address.description: Real id of the member device involved in this operation.

is_controller.description: For add_member: whether this member controls the scene (true) or responds to it (false, default).

name.description: Optional display name to associate with the member, for add_member.

link.description: For update_link: the new link behavior parameters (e.g. on-level, ramp rate) to apply.
